problem.title: L-LO on KITTI Odom seq 07 full: landmark extraction, finer clustering cells
problem.question: Which setting gives the lowest error on seq 07? Seq 07 is the only sequence used for choosing parameters; 00/02/05/08 stay held out.

variants.label: cluster cell 0p25
variants.intent: Change from the repository defaults: cluster_cell=0.25
variants.note: Landmark convex-hull overlap odometry, frame-to-frame (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose). mean_matches=35.9791 frames_below_3_matches=0/1100
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.
